board.text: Injury opportunity: Xavier Hutchinson (WR, HOU) steps in for Nico Collins (Out) and nobody has him - proj 6.5, under the radar. 3 free next-men in total.
Woody Marks (BN3, value 5.6/wk) - Upgrade after this week (his best week is now): drop for Ollie Gordon (+3.3/wk)

Morgan is shopping Alvin Kamara, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Tre Tucker, Tyler Warren: nothing there beats what you would have to give - pass, or wait for the price to drop

Next week: Harrison Butker is on bye - plan the replacement now
Quentin Johnston: 377,881 teams dropped him in the last day (rostered 58%). The crowd is bailing
League rosters are 39 h old - the Yahoo pull did not run
